articles.summary: EAU CLAIRE, Wis., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Citizens Community Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: CZWI), the parent company of CCFBank N.A. (the “Bank” or “CCFBank”), today reported earnings of $5.4 million and earnings per diluted share of $0.56 for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1.1 million and earnings per diluted share of $0.11 for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, and $3.7 million and $0.37 earnings per diluted share for the quarter ended September
articles.title: Citizens Community Bancorp, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Earnings of $0.56 Per Share; Board Approves 14% Increase in Quarterly Dividend to $0.12 per Share
